text:
A weekend filled with shock results across the continent leaves plenty to unpack, while the upcoming fixtures feature a massive divergence in Italy.

The standout situation for expected value comes in Serie A, where Lecce travel to Frosinone. Bet365 rates Lecce at just a 20.0% chance to win, offering odds of 5.0. The model, however, assigns the visitors a 45.9% probability. That gap produces a notable expected value of 116.3%, making an away win an outcome worth a closer look.

Reflecting on the latest action, Serie A delivered some of the model's sharpest calls. It strongly backed Inter’s 2-0 win at Venezia with a 91.5% chance and Napoli’s 4-1 triumph at Monza at 80.1%. Those picks produced tiny log loss scores of 0.089 and 0.222 respectively, comfortably outperforming Bet365 since lower log loss denotes better predictive accuracy. Both were caught out by Bologna’s 4-2 win at AC Milan at 5.75 odds, though the model took less of a hit.

In the Premier League, Fulham’s 1-0 victory at Coventry was a decisive hit for the model, which gave them a 59.7% chance. The model also held up better against Aston Villa’s 2-1 upset over Manchester City, giving Villa a 28.6% shot where Bet365 priced them at 5.0.

Other leagues delivered stubborn misses for both sides. In the Bundesliga, Borussia Monchengladbach’s 3-2 victory at Stuttgart at 7.0 odds was a hefty miss all round. Meanwhile in Spain, Real Madrid’s 2-1 win at Barcelona in El Clasico proved costly for the model, which had given Barcelona a 64.9% chance of taking the points.
